message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout that lasted longer than I expected. I grabbed my trusty flashlight and settled in with a few snacks, but what really kept me entertained was our family group chat. Everyone was sharing their own blackout experiences, from trying to find their power banks to amusingly arguing over which snacks were the best for a power outage. It reminded me how important it is to stay connected, even in the dark. Have you ever had a funny family moment during an unexpected outage?
